title: NeMo Eval Author tool-call measurement details
description: Method-specific details for deterministic tool-call coverage measurement.

schema.description: Version marker for tool-call measurement details.

audit.description: Audit spec metadata for the denominator used by this measurement.

subject.description: Provider-neutral identity of the measured task/run artifact.

method.description: Measurement method that produced this details file.

item_kind.description: Audit item kind measured by tool-call coverage.

audit_tools.description: Tool item names declared by the audit denominator.

covered.description: Audit tool names observed in the trace.

missing.description: Audit tool names not observed in the trace.

observed_tool_calls.description: All named TOOL spans found in the trace, depth-first.

tool_call_counts.description: Observed tool call counts keyed by tool name.

matches.description: Observed tool calls grouped by matching audit tool name.

nonEmptyString.description: String value that must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

itemName.description: Stable machine-readable audit item or tool name.

pathString.description: Local file or directory path recorded as a string.

audit.description: Identity and status of the audit denominator used for this measurement. Details readers use this to connect method-specific evidence back to the same denominator as coverage.json.

path.description: Path to the audit.md file measured against.

schema.description: Schema version of the audit denominator.

agent.description: Agent name declared by the audit denominator.

status.description: Review state of the audit denominator when this measurement was produced.

item_count.description: Number of audit items in the denominator when this measurement was produced.

subject.description: The measured task or run. Keep this provider-neutral so coverage and details files can be read without understanding the runner that produced the trace.

trace.description: Path to the interaction trace that was measured.

trace_format.description: Normalized trace model the measurement method read.

source_kind.description: Source format the trace was loaded from by the shared NeMo Compass loader.

task_id.description: Stable task, scenario, or case identifier for grouping measurements.

run_id.description: Identifier for the specific run, trial, attempt, or repetition measured.

span_id.description: Id of the TOOL span in the loaded NeMo Compass trace.
